name: kfw-escape
description: Die Bruecke zur Zwei-Programme-Welt - internes Multiplayer Fantasy-Escape-Browsergame

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kfw-escape/shared && npm run build -w @kfw-escape/server && npm run build -w @kfw-escape/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @kfw-escape/server" "npm run dev -w @kfw-escape/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kfw-escape/shared && npm run typecheck -w @kfw-escape/server && npm run typecheck -w @kfw-escape/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
